# Best Budget Laptops for College Work

You want a **14-inch laptop under $700** with **16 GB RAM, 512 GB SSD, and 8+ hours of battery** for Docs, Zoom, and light photo editing. I’m ranking by **value + portability**, with a bias toward thin, reliable student machines.

## Ranked Laptop Comparison

| Rank | Laptop | Price Range | Screen | RAM / SSD | Battery | Main Tradeoff |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Acer Swift Go 14** | $650–$700 | 14" | 16 GB / 512 GB | 8–10 hrs | Best overall value, but speakers/trackpad are just okay |
| 2 | **ASUS Zenbook 14** | $680–$700 | 14" | 16 GB / 512 GB | 9–12 hrs | Usually the best build quality, but pricing can be tight |
| 3 | **Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 5 14** | $600–$680 | 14" | 16 GB / 512 GB | 8–11 hrs | Great practicality, but display quality varies by config |

## Value Ranking and Tradeoffs

### 1) Acer Swift Go 14 — Best value pick
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/laptop.svg
- Strong balance of **price, portability, and specs**.
- Usually the easiest to find with **16 GB RAM + 512 GB SSD** inside budget.
- Good for Google Docs, Zoom, and light photo work; the display is typically solid enough for casual editing.
- Tradeoff: not the most premium feel, and battery life is good rather than class-leading.

### 2) ASUS Zenbook 14 — Best premium-feeling option
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/laptop.svg
- Often the **best portable experience**: lighter chassis, better keyboard/trackpad, and strong battery.
- Excellent if you carry it all day and want a more polished feel.
- Tradeoff: at this budget, some configs may force you to compromise on screen type or processor.

### 3) Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 5 14 — Best practical budget choice
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/laptop.svg
- Usually the **most straightforward “student laptop”**: good specs, good battery, sensible pricing.
- Nice choice if you want to save a bit without dropping below your required memory/storage.
- Tradeoff: display and build can be less consistent than the top two.

## Best Pick for Portability

**Recommended: ASUS Zenbook 14**

Why it wins for portability:
- Typically **lighter and slimmer**
- Better to carry between classes
- Usually has the **best battery life** of the three
- Feels more premium for daily use

If you want the **best value overall**, pick the **Acer Swift Go 14**.
If you want the **most portable and polished** experience, pick the **ASUS Zenbook 14**.
